targets.baseline_commit_message: Close the open tie lines: device, model cache, stores and checkouts the place reports

preserve: every 9th transcript in name order, at most 25, sentences of 9 to 22 words, seed 7, 40 takes

faults cycle complete, complete, cut, restart, selfcorrect; cut keeps 45-70 percent and at least 3 words; restart says 2-4 words then 'uh, sorry, let me start again.'; selfcorrect adds ', no wait, that's wrong, let me redo that.'
accuracy at 0.5, per fault, and abstention lines 0.7, 0.8, 0.9
allowed_deltas: its fixed paths, model names, prompts and words of the person became request fields, read with the person's list:settings row under them (read-data/computer.py request)
one JSON line out ({ result } or { error }) instead of a file written beside the script; print lines kept
banned_substitutions: a person's path, model list, vocabulary or question written in code
a second settings reader beside tools/settings
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
